# cosmo_persisted_operations (Data Source)

Reads the persisted operations registered for a client of a federated graph.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cosmo_persisted_operations" "test" {
  federated_graph_name = var.federated_graph_name
  namespace            = var.namespace
  client_name          = var.client_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_name` (String) The name of the client the operations belong to.
- `federated_graph_name` (String) The name of the federated graph.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the federated graph. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The unique identifier of the client.
- `operations` (Attributes List) The persisted operations registered for the client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operations))

<a id="nestedatt--operations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operations`

Read-Only:

- `contents` (String) The GraphQL operation contents.
- `created_at` (String) The time the operation was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the operation (the SHA-256 hash of its contents).
- `last_updated_at` (String) The time the operation was last updated.
- `operation_names` (List of String) The names of the operations contained in the document.
